name: Shiro to Kuro no Densetsu ~Hyakki Hen~
source: Story begins with an incident in a psychiatric hospital - at midnight the third floor of the building suddenly burst into flames. Reporter from the local newspaper arrived on the scene to write an article. After interviewing witnesses it appears that the fire started in the chamber of 301 - but the cause of fire remained unknown. Moreover, the patient of this chamber disappeared - even his body could not be found. After a long search, the reporter still finds the missing patient on the streets - but he just mumbles some strange prophecies. The next day, the usual trip on the train turns into a nightmare for our reporter: when the train enters a tunnel, the world outside the window suddenly begins to change and he find ourselves in a terrible alternative world. But all this is only a prelude to the coming apocalypse.
translation: 故事始于一家精神病院：午夜时分，大楼三楼突然起火。当地报社记者赶到现场撰写报道。采访目击者后得知，火灾始于301号病房，但起火原因仍然不明。更奇怪的是，这个病房里的病人失踪了，连尸体也找不到。经过长时间搜寻，记者终于在街上找到失踪病人，但对方只会喃喃说出奇怪的预言。第二天，记者像往常一样乘坐火车，却经历了噩梦般的旅程：列车驶入隧道时，窗外世界突然开始改变，他发现自己身处可怕的异世界。然而，这一切还只是末日降临的序幕。
